results.limitations: Pair metrics use reference domain classes only. Missing predictions create no positive links. Shared associations use shared-class/domain-class anchors, ignoring service label spelling. Groups with no domain anchors cannot be assessed by association pairs. Infrastructure contributes to coverage and shared detection, not domain pair quality. Zero-denominator metrics are null; no perfect score is inferred.
